//: An NPC eats moth jelly (Backrooms Expanded). Compares item ids as text, so it loads and simply never fires without that mod. At most once a day per NPC.
An NPC eats a royal ration (Backrooms Expanded). At most once a day per NPC.
An NPC drinks cloudy water / liquid pain (Backrooms Expanded). NPCs never pick it themselves, so this is when the player hands it to them. At most once a day per NPC.

text: Ate moth jelly today.  Felt better than I have in weeks.
Scraped jelly off a dead moth and ate it.  Tasted like honey.  I'm not proud.
The moth stuff actually works.  My cuts stopped stinging.
Moth jelly for lunch.  Sweet, warm, a bit glowy.  Don't think about it.
Found a royal ration.  It tasted like my mother's stew.  I had to sit down after.
One little bar and I'm full for the day.  Nobody knows who makes them.
Ate a royal ration.  It tasted like a birthday.  Whose, I couldn't say.
Royal ration.  Best thing I've eaten since all this started.
Drank what I thought was almond water.  It wasn't.  Everything still hurts.
The bad water.  I should have smelled it first.  I won't make that mistake twice.
Liquid pain, they call it.  They're not exaggerating.
Someone handed me a bottle of the bad stuff.  I'm going to remember that.
